thread:
nina: ran a targeted doc-scan on staging at ~21:40 — found 7 internal refs to removed anchors in /guides/serving and one stale example in /api/clients.md. also one image returning 403 from the staging asset bucket. small fixes but blocking a review batch. who can grab?

rohan: I can take the failing image. likely an S3 ACL issue. Which asset path?

nina: it's /assets/diagrams/pool-layout.png referenced from guides/serving/throughput.md, returns 403 on preview. scan details in /tmp/docscan/6712343210.json.

ci-bot: doc-scan: report generated (6712343210) — 7 broken anchors, 1 403 asset, 1 deprecated client call `createStream` in api/clients.md.

pat: i'll pick the deprecated client call. quick checklist: update snippet to `client.responses.stream()` and add a short note about fallback behavior. will open a PR and add the deprecation row to the tracker.

ux: i'll help with the anchor changes — sounds like a heading rename without alias. can you list the exact anchors?

nina: anchors: `#sharding` referenced from three pages, header changed to "Shard planning" ; `#streaming-pipeline` referenced once. i can paste the grep output if helpful.

pat: for the snippet patch, i'll run a dry replace across docs with: `rg "createStream\(" -l docs/ | xargs -n1 sed -n '1,200p'` and then apply replacements in a branch. i'll PR tonight.

rohan: reuploaded pool-layout.png to the team bucket with public-read and pushed a small versioned path /assets/diagrams/pool-layout-v2.png. opened PR branch docs/fix-pool-image.

ux: added HTML anchor alias above the header for streaming-pipeline and shimmed `id` for sharding (so old links resolve). branch docs/anchors-shim and PR https://github.internal/redwood/pull/2987

pat: PR https://github.internal/redwood/pull/2988 opened with client snippet updates and changelog note. included abort example.

ci-bot: CI: queued docs-lint for PRs 2987, 2988, 2989; running link-check and mdx-lint.

nina: quick nit: can reviewers pay attention to the Netlify redirect entry I added for one deprecated shortlink? it needs the proper status code 301 -> redirect table.

rohan: spotted a flaky mdx-lint warning on line endings in serving/throughput.md — i'll run prettier with the docs config before merge.

pat: added myself to the docs-owners sheet (tab: Guides) and left a comment on the PR about ownership.

ux: i'll review the anchor shim PR and do a quick visual preview. if green, plan: merge in the 00:30 UTC window and deploy 03:00 UTC.

nina: thanks all. i'll watch CI and post a one-line summary in #eng-status after deploy. if anything blocks, i'll ping @eng-oncall and open an incident stub.

rohan: thx — i'll tidy the image PR to remove large binary diffs.

pat: pinging reviewers for quick LGTM. small async fixes, should be fast.
